description: This file defines the CustomerGrain class for Orleans, implementing customer-related state management and behaviors, including setting customer info, adding devices, and setting random state for testing.

classes.name: CustomerGrain
classes.description: Represents a customer entity in Orleans, managing customer state and behaviors.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Overrides the Orleans activation method to perform initialization tasks.

methods.name: IntroduceSelf
methods.description: Returns a greeting string with the customer's first and last name.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the customer ID, first name, and last name, then writes the state.

methods.name: AddDevice
methods.description: Adds a device to the customer's device list and sets ownership.

methods.name: SetRandomState
methods.description: Populates the customer state with random data for testing purposes.
